SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN at.nm = 'Home' THEN be.bsns_entt_id END) AS home_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN at.nm = 'Shipping' THEN be.bsns_entt_id END) AS shipping_count
FROM biz_ent be
JOIN biz_addr ba ON ba.ref1 = be.bsns_entt_id
JOIN addr_typ at ON ba.ref3 = at.addr_typ_id
WHERE at.nm IN ('Home', 'Shipping')

SELECT CONCAT_WS(' ', prsn.frst_nm, prsn.mddl_nm, prsn.lst_nm) AS sales_person, sls_terr.nm AS territory
FROM stor
JOIN sls_prsn ON stor.ref1 = sls_prsn.ref2
JOIN prsn ON sls_prsn.ref2 = prsn.ref1
JOIN sls_terr ON sls_prsn.ref1 = sls_terr.trrt_id
WHERE stor.nm = 'Area Bike Accessories'

SELECT vnd.nm
FROM vnd
JOIN prod_vnd ON vnd.ref1 = prod_vnd.ref2
JOIN prod ON prod.prdc_id = prod_vnd.ref3
WHERE prod.nm = 'Women''s Tights'
SELECT MAX(bm_lvl) FROM bom WHERE ref3 = (SELECT prdc_id FROM prod WHERE nm = 'HL Road Frame - Black, 58')

SELECT pc.nm AS product_category, SUM(sod.ordr_qty) AS total_quantity_sold, SUM(sod.ln_ttl) AS total_revenue
FROM prod_cat pc
JOIN prod_sub ps ON ps.ref1 = pc.prdc_ctgr_id
JOIN prod p ON p.ref2 = ps.prdc_sbct_id
JOIN so_dtl sod ON sod.ref2 = p.prdc_id
GROUP BY pc.prdc_ctgr_id, pc.nm

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM so_hdr JOIN cust ON so_hdr.ref8 = cust.cstm_id JOIN sls_terr ON cust.ref1 = sls_terr.trrt_id JOIN cnty ON sls_terr.ref1 = cnty.cntr_rgn_cd WHERE YEAR(so_hdr.ordr_dt) = 2013 AND cnty.nm = 'Canada'

SELECT p.nm
FROM prod p
WHERE p.fnsh_gds_flg = 1
AND NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM so_dtl d
  WHERE d.ref2 = p.prdc_id
)

SELECT SUM(sd.ln_ttl) AS total_revenue
FROM so_dtl sd
JOIN so_hdr sh ON sd.ref3 = sh.sls_ordr_id
JOIN prod p ON sd.ref2 = p.prdc_id
JOIN prod_sub ps ON p.ref2 = ps.prdc_sbct_id
JOIN prod_cat pc ON ps.ref1 = pc.prdc_ctgr_id
WHERE pc.nm = 'Bikes' AND YEAR(sh.ordr_dt) = 2013
